units: <cite ref="Berakhot 10a:27">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>לך ובקר את הח׳</he> go and visit the sick (King).
<cite ref="Berakhot 54b:16">Ib. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שהיה ח׳ וכ׳</he> he who has been sick and recovered.
<cite ref="Berakhot 54b:16">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>ח׳ חתן וכ׳</he> a sick person, a bridegroom &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00346"><he>חוֹלִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00351"><he>חוֹלִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:1">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ מן השעבוד</he> suffering from oppression.
<cite ref="Gittin 28a:7">Gitt. 28ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>רוב ח׳ לחיים</he> the majority of the sick recover again.
Ib. 61ᵃ מבקרין חוֹלֵי נכרים וכ׳ you are bound to visit the sick of the gentile community alike with &c.; a. fr.—ביקור ח׳, v. בִּיקּוּר.—Fem. חוֹלָה.
<cite ref="Sotah 36b:12">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ היא</he> that she was sick.—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII, 14</cite> (play on <he>לחילה</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:6">ib.</cite>) <he>לאותה הח׳ שהיא עתידה להיות ח׳</he> (pay attention) to that sick (nation), for she is destined to be sick (suffering). Cant. R. l. c.; a. fr.
